description: This file defines the BucketEndpointArnMiddleware class, a middleware component for AWS SDK PHP that handles ARNs in S3 bucket operations, specifically targeting access point ARNs and adjusting endpoints accordingly.

classes.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class to handle ARN-based endpoints in AWS S3, supporting access point ARNs, multi-region access points, and related endpoint configurations.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a wrapper function to instantiate the middleware with necessary parameters.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with handler, service, region, configuration, and endpoint versioning.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::__invoke
methods.description: Main middleware logic invoked during request processing; handles ARN parsing, validation, and request modification for S3.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::generateAccessPointHost
methods.description: Generates the appropriate hostname for an access point ARN, considering different ARN types and configurations.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::validateArn
methods.description: Validates an ARN object, ensuring compatibility with the current configuration and region, and returns the ARN's partition if valid.

methods.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware::isGlobal
methods.description: Checks if the specified region is considered a global endpoint region in S3.
